__prompts__.author_email: Contact e-mail (EBI's InterProScan API requires one)
__prompts__.baits: Bait specs, comma-separated (AlphaPulldown syntax: ID | ID:N | ID:start-stop | ID:N:start-stop)
__prompts__.preys: Prey specs, comma-separated (same syntax; edit configs/preys_<run>.txt later for long lists)
__prompts__.organism_taxon: NCBI taxon id of the screen (decoy pool, same-organism partners); 3702 = Arabidopsis
__prompts__.fragment_mode: Fragment mode: cut baits and preys into their domains (two-hybrid style)?
__prompts__.positive_controls: Add the baits' known direct partners as positive controls?
__prompts__.decoys: Add a matched decoy prey set (calibrated hit calling)?
__prompts__.n_decoys: Number of decoy preys (each folded with every bait)
__prompts__.max_tokens: ESMFold2 limit on total residues per pair (memory grows ~quadratically)
